title: Verra pipeline table
description: One table in one layer. Every file in schema/<layer>/ follows this format; the pipeline checks it on start-up.

$schema.description: Path to this format file (src/verra_pipeline/formats/table.schema.json), so editors can check the file as you type.

layer.description: The layer the table belongs to. Must match the folder the file is in.

name.description: The table name. Must match the file name without .json.

description.description: What the table holds, in one or two sentences.

source.description: Bronze only: the source system the table belongs to and, unless it is the system's quarantine table, the file it is loaded from.

system.description: The source system, as named under 'sources' in the config, e.g. verra.

file_prefix.description: The part of the file name before _<YYYY-MM-DD>.csv, e.g. VerraRetirements.

role.description: Bronze only: 'quarantine' marks the table that receives every record of its source system that could not be read.

unknown_columns.description: Bronze only: what to do with a column the file has but this table does not declare. 'keep' adds it at the end as text; 'drop' leaves it out. Either way it is reported.

columns.description: The table's own columns, in output order.

include.description: Shared column sets from schema/shared/, added after the table's own columns in this order.

primary_key.description: Silver and gold: the columns that identify a row.

foreign_keys.description: Silver and gold: columns that must match a row in another table.

type.description: integer is 64-bit; date has no time of day.

nullable.description: false means an empty value is an error.

required.description: Bronze only: the source file must have this column, or the run stops.

source_header.description: Bronze only: the header in the source file that feeds this column.

aliases.description: Bronze only: other headers accepted for this column, e.g. after Verra renames one.

generated.description: A value the pipeline fills in instead of reading it from a file.
